newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * Lower Chamber of Deputies rejected a simple motion on new road tax lodged by the main opposition Party of Social Democracy (PDSR).

Transport Minister Traian Basescu said the tax was vital for the country's efforts to set up a permanent fund for road maintenance and repairs. He said the government would discuss the final form of the road tax decree in its Wednesday session.
* President Emil Constantinescu chairs a meeting of the national action council on fighting corruption and organised crime on progress in preventing widespread fraud and smuggling.
* The opposition Party of Social Democracy (PDSR) will file a new simple motion to parliament against the government's plans to change the local administration law.

PDSR executive leader Adrian Nastase said his party was planning to introduce no-confidence motion at the end of June accusingthe centrist coalition government of failing to fulfil its electoral promises.
Nastase acknowledged the existence of groupings within the party ahead of its national conference on June 20-21, but said ex-president Ion Iliescu would be reconfirmed as party leader.
